about: compiler/nativeobj: the Ergo producer of a Go archive (route C, NATIVE-OBJECT-ROUNDTRIP and Stop 1 widening). Each row breaks one contract of the archive; verify.ergo/slots.ergo/handoff.ergo laws kill it through the independent decoders.

mutants.name: wrong-pkgdef-fingerprint
mutants.rule: The export data ends with the first 8 bytes of its SHA-256, and the object header carries the same fingerprint (the linker compares it with every importer's record).

mutants.name: own-archive-member-missing
mutants.rule: The archive holds both members the producer wrote, __.PKGDEF then _go_.o; neither is left to a stock tool.

mutants.name: wrong-abi-arg
mutants.rule: ABIInternal passes integer argument pieces in RAX, RBX, RCX, RDI, RSI, R8..R11; the prologue takes each piece from its assigned register.

mutants.name: live-slot-unmarked
mutants.rule: At each call the locals pointer map marks every pointer word live across it, so the GC keeps its object and the stack copier moves a stack pointer.

mutants.name: wrong-safe-pc
mutants.rule: The stack-map index at a call's return address minus one names that call's own map.

mutants.name: missing-pointer-barrier
mutants.rule: A heap pointer store runs the write barrier whenever runtime.writeBarrier is set.

mutants.name: reloc-target-swapped
mutants.rule: Each relocation names the symbol its instruction calls or reads.

mutants.name: init-double-run
mutants.rule: The inittask lists each init function once, so the runtime runs it once.

mutants.name: handoff-skip-admit
mutants.rule: FromHandoff must admit the decoded EIR v1 image against the independent compile tuple and peer import identities before translating or emitting an archive.

mutants.name: handoff-drop-pointer-barrier
mutants.rule: An EIR v1 HOStore into a pointer-containing destination must translate to StorePtr so the write barrier is emitted.

mutants.name: handoff-drop-const-high-word
mutants.from:
let hiSigned = if hi >= uint32(0x80000000) { int(hi) - 4294967296 } else { int(hi) }
	(hiSigned << 32) | int(lo)
mutants.rule: HOConst must reconstruct the full signed 64-bit integer from both low and high EIR v1 literal words.

mutants.name: handoff-reverse-init-order
mutants.from: let symIdx = int(try hword(img, ir.HInit, i, 0)) - 1
mutants.to: let symIdx = int(try hword(img, ir.HInit, nInits-1-i, 0)) - 1
mutants.rule: FromHandoff must preserve HInit semantic initializer order rather than reversing or resorting it.

mutants.name: nativeobj-stop1-cold-nop-dropped
mutants.rule: Cold panic calls end with a NOP inside the caller's active frame and cold stack-map span so return PCs never step onto morestackLabel.

mutants.name: nativeobj-stop1-heap-struct-barrier-dropped
mutants.rule: Multi-word heap stores (FieldSet and SliceLit) must emit write barriers on every pointer word inside the stored record, slice, or string.

mutants.name: nativeobj-stop1-prologue-order
mutants.rule: Prologue must spill all incoming register parameters before stack-parameter copies clobber RAX.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-closure-morestack-nocontext
mutants.from: a.CallSym(if hasEnv { RuntimeMorestack } else { MorestackNoctxt }, ABI0, true)
mutants.to: a.CallSym(if false && hasEnv { RuntimeMorestack } else { MorestackNoctxt }, ABI0, true)
mutants.rule: Functions capturing a ClosureEnv must split the stack via runtime.morestack so RDX closure context is preserved across stack growth.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-initorder-dropped
mutants.rule: Package .inittask must emit RInitorder relocations for every imported dependency that has an init task.

mutants.name: nativeobj-exec-main-header-omitted
mutants.from: let hdr = if p.Name == "main" { header + "main\n" } else { header }
mutants.rule: Main package archives must include the standalone 'main' header line before '!\n' so the Go linker recognizes the executable root package.
